name: agent-07-bicycle-understeer-v1
description: Per-platform calibrated steady-state bicycle yaw predictor with v^2 understeer term. Replaces V0 KS psi_dot = (v/L) tan(delta) with v*delta/(L_eff + K_us*v^2) + biases, fit per platform on yaw+CTE blend. Tesla is V0 passthrough by design.
objective: yaw_plus_cte (yaw_rmse + cte_rmse/1000), per-platform L-BFGS-B with NM rescue
